name: reactemaileditor
description: React Email Editor based on Unlayer's wrapper component available at https://github.com/unlayer/react-email-editor
author: Stoneworx
comment_mendix11: Aligned to Mendix 11.12.6 (React client, React 19.2.3), matching the demo app.
The toolchain and the mendix typings stay on 11.12.x even though newer
releases exist: the toolchain major/minor and React must match the target
Studio Pro. react must not appear in dependencies or the toolchain prompts
to migrate and silently builds nothing; pin it through resolutions and
overrides instead. Rebuild whenever the app's Mendix version changes.
@swc/core is pinned for npm test only: from 1.16.12 its Windows binding
refuses to load unless no ancestor of its cache folder grants other users
write access, which C:\ does by default, so jest finds no tests to run.
